note: Nobles County park on the east shore of West Graham Lake near Fulda, with lake access, a swimming beach, a picnic shelter, a historic site and a one-room bunk cabin; the campsites are on a wooded strip between the lake and the county road. --Claude
summary: County pages read: first come (no reservations for camper lots), $25 electric / $15 non-electric, weekly/monthly/seasonal rates, half price after Labor Day, showers, water supply, electricity. Stored lakeview is unsupported (continuous canopy 25-55 m to the shore): recommend not waterfront. Note cleaned of the Murray County error. Phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakeview -> not waterfront (stored value is not --AWH): on Esri and NAIP imagery the park is a narrow strip of dense deciduous canopy between West Graham Lake and the county road; the camp clearings near 43.8063-43.8075,-95.5030 sit about 25-55 m back from the shoreline behind a continuous wooded bank, and no pad or open ground to the water can be seen. The stored evidence itself says 'canopy blocks confirmation of any open-bank site'. The county posts no site map or campsite photos showing a view. Default down.

LONG-STAY (information): the county sells monthly ($450) and season-long ($950, May 1 - Labor Day) sites at the same first-come camper lots; no county page says how many lots go seasonal. Imagery cannot count RVs under the canopy. Google Maps shows 4.5 stars from only 2 reviews. Not enough to call it mostly seasonal; a reviewer may want to phone the parks office.

HOOKUPS: the county says only 'Campers have access to electricity and a water supply' (no amperage, no statement of water at the site). The stored hookups.water true (derived from the sweep note) is unconfirmed; left alone. Non-electric $15 sites are not described as tent-only or RV, so the base stays at the $25 electric rate.
WEBSITE: the stored parks department page works; the park's own description is at https://www.co.nobles.mn.us/departments/public-works/parks/nobles-county-parks/ (suggest adding or replacing).
PHONE 507-468-2224 confirmed (Parks Office, county parks page).
PIN 43.806264,-95.503187 is in the wooded strip; Google's park point 43.8097,-95.5020 is ~390 m north at the park's north end. The camp loop cannot be placed under the canopy, so no move proposed.
LEAD: Fury's Island County Park, 'one mile south of Maka-Oicu', on East/West Graham Lakes, Nobles County, offers camping and showers; not in campgrounds.json (no entry within 5 km). Unvetted.
